user.title: Wi-Fi Analyzer
user.description:
Found **{count}** probes: {host} server Wi-Fi cards and {shelly} Shelly devices.

Choose which ones to use for scans. A Shelly leaves Wi-Fi for about 3 seconds while scanning: 4-6 of them, one per room, are enough.

abort.no_probes: No probe found: you need a Shelly Gen2 or later, or a Wi-Fi card on the Home Assistant server (HA OS).

data.panel: Show the panel in the sidebar

data_description.own_ssids: Empty: detected from the connected devices.
data_description.scan_hours: 0 = on demand only. Each scan takes the Shelly probes off Wi-Fi for a few seconds.
data_description.channel_plan: 1-6-11 is the standard. 1-5-9-13 is used in Europe where no neighbor follows 1-6-11.

openwrt.title: OpenWrt routers
openwrt.description: For OpenWrt routers without an integration in Home Assistant. Needs LuCI (or uhttpd with ubus). root works out of the box; another user needs an rpcd ACL for iwinfo (see README).

scan.name: Start scan
scan.description: Runs a Wi-Fi scan with the selected probes and returns a summary.
